$comment: English texts of data/towers.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the two System Towers and the sentences of a Tower fight's report. Each key keeps the Polish number of variants, as the engine picks one by index. „Piętro” is a floor; the stone floor underfoot („posadzka”) is the flagstones, so the two do not mix.

defeat: The System leads {target} out of the Tower.
Fight lost. The System leads {target} out of the Tower.
eliteStart: The floor falls silent. Tower elite: {enemies}.
championStart: The flagstones tremble under heavy steps. Tower champion: {enemies}.
The whole Tower goes quiet and waits. The champion steps out: {enemies}.
chest: A Tower chest waits on this floor. Inside: {item}.
